title: Component Libraries
summary: A component library provides reusable, tested behavior; reuse matters only when it fits the task.

MUST.text: Document API, anatomy, variants, states and accessibility behavior for each component.
Provide usage and non-usage guidance plus keyboard and screen-reader behavior.

SHOULD.text: Test components in realistic content, responsive contexts and with assistive tech.

AVOID.text: Do not create variants for one-off preferences or force unrelated patterns together.
Do not ship a component without tests for loading, error and empty states.

DECIDE.decision: Keep for one release with warning

EXAMPLE.good: "Button owns focus, loading and disabled behavior; page owns composition."
EXAMPLE.bad: "A styled div passed off as a button with no keyboard support."

FAILURE_MODES: Undocumented APIs lead to misuse and inconsistent behavior.
Components tested only in isolation fail with real content.
Variant sprawl recreates one-offs inside the library.
